ledger.source_art_note: Identity-approved is not slot-approved and neither is release-cleared

global_contract: Mass-centred prayer companion; no detached duplicate engines or route regressions
Original 18 reviewer decisions are immutable source-of-truth and all remain REVISE until explicit user approval
Exact Claude design references are targets, not proof of implemented visual parity
Text first, discreet source/provenance controls; preserve authentic historical 1962/form variants, language faces and ℣/℟
Full canonical Rosary reader and 5/15 support; 15 traditional mysteries by default where the user's rule applies
Compact progress and touch targets; no numeric-box ribbons, oversized method/source pills or gratuitous helper copy
Art may be re-used across covers and within prayers; slot/subject/painting fit, rights and visual quality reviewed separately
No framed reproductions, no unapproved photo publication or invented art bindings; zero-cost storage only
Calendar recommendations must come from canonical calendar source and real saved continuation state
Actual 320×568 and 390×844 screenshots compared against prototypes; green CI alone never constitutes editorial acceptance
Keep draft PR #2079 (F04/Discovery) and draft PR #2104 (Rosary spacing) unmerged and non-publishing
